title: Reported primitives count seem excessive and hard to understand
body: ### Tested versions v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439] ### System information not relevant I would think ### Issue description Hi, I'm using the Information dock, to display statistics about the scene, and the addon Mesh Inspector, to obtain information about meshes (vertices, primitives). I've noticed that the number of primitives in the Information dock seem excessive. 1. it includes the physics debug primitives, which I did not know, then I hid them 2. it still seem too much 3. [Performance](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_performance.html) indicates it might double or triple the actual count, but it's still seem excessive Pre-"edit": I've hid everything but 2 nodes: 15 vertex 13 faces + 300 vertex 150 faces And the primitive count is 13K Post "edit": I actually found the answer while creating the issue, there is a node that inherits Path3D, 12K primitives come from this node. Possible duplicates: I've looked up "is:issue primitives count", "is:issue primitives" This seem to have been rollback? https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/59557 Found some people in other websites mentioning it, and mentioning the light (that's not the case here). So: - Maybe the Information dock should be more explicit and/or add more information, because I had 17K primitives, 200 from the actual geometry, and the rest from Godot - Maybe a mouse over tooltip to explain what "Primitives" means - Maybe it should indicates the primitives's origins (Godot, Collider, Path3D etc) if possible - Maybe the Information dock uses the class Performance, and the information does not seem present (otherwise I could try to make a simple addon) => 🤷‍♂️ - So maybe Performance could be more detailed - We don't seem to have access to the Mesh information of the Path3D (for an addon like Mesh Inspector), maybe it should be made available, if not computed on the fly - It does not seem to have a LOD on the Path3D, it's probably fine though It would be nice because I was attempting to optimize my scene, and a big part of the reported primitive count was from Godot, in this situation, in the Editor. Maybe this will be useful to someone encountering the same issue, maybe it should be a proposal (I haven't checked if there is one yet), let me know. ### Steps to reproduce In the MRP: - Install Mesh Inspector - Open the scene SampleIsland1 - Hide everything but SandBlock (first node) - In SandBlock > Shaper > Wall Shaper > Curve, change bake resolution to 5 - Hide the StaticBodies (can, can also not do it) In this one, you get 27 vertex 25 faces + 540 vertex 270 faces, but you get 16K or 12K primitives in the Information dock. There is probably no need to attempt to reproduce it 🤷‍♂️ ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) https://github.com/solodeveloping/test-goshapes-bug-1
